title: Evaluate Repository Reconnaissance Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for approval dates, trace the form event through validation, state, generated manifest, storage output, tests, and README examples; mark automatic-date behaviour unsupported if no owning path exists.
acceptance_criteria: A repository map containing entry points, owners, dependencies, state or data transitions, consumers, and external boundaries.
A success-path and failure-path trace with exact files, symbols, routes, commands, or configuration keys.
An inventory of relevant tests, fixtures, documentation, generated sources, and release checks.
A confirmed/inferred/unknown ledger for unresolved dynamic wiring or inaccessible systems.
failure_signals: Reject ownership conclusions based only on file names or search frequency.
Reject unrequested edits, cleanup, or architecture changes during a read-only mapping task.
